fact: Proparco, a French development finance subsidiary of AFD Group, committed USD 5m (EUR 4.3m) in equity to TLcom Capital's TIDE Africa Fund I, a venture fund the document says is Mauritius-registered and invests in Sub-Saharan African start-ups.

ImpactAlpha reports that Mauritius-based fintech Kuunda raised a USD 7.5 million pre-Series A round backed by Seedstars Africa Ventures, Accion Ventures, Nedbank, E4E Africa, 4Di Capital and Portugal Gateway Fund.
